In frame_0.50.png, spatial_grounder detects the glass bottle body at bbox [210, 372, 416, 620] with confidence 0.98 and the blue liquid region at bbox [210, 492, 416, 620] with confidence 0.97. Using these grounded boxes, the bottle body's visible height is 620-372 = 248 px and the liquid height is 620-492 = 128 px.

That gives a filled fraction of about 128/248 ≈ 0.52 from the tool-reported heights in frame_0.50.png. The other grounded frames are similar but still approximate: at 1.5s the ratio is 129/245 ≈ 0.53, and at 3.0s it is 137/242 ≈ 0.57.

So the bottle appears a little over half full, based on the spatial_grounder detections rather than any text cue. Among the choices, 3/5 = 0.60 is the closest available option to the grounded visual estimate.
